wakes.configuration.title: %s Config
wakes.configuration.pickBoat.tooltip: Enables you to quickly grab a boat when middle clicking water.
wakes.configuration.fluidWhitelist.toolt: List of fluid IDs that can produce wakes
wakes.configuration.mobBlacklist.tooltip: List of entity type IDs that should not produce wakes
wakes.configuration.boatSpawning.tooltip: What effect should be visible when a boat moves in water?
wakes.configuration.playerSpawning.toolt: What effect should be visible when you move in water?
wakes.configuration.otherPlayersSpawning: What effect should be visible when other players move in water?
wakes.configuration.mobSpawning.tooltip: What effect should be visible when mobs move in water?
wakes.configuration.itemSpawning.tooltip: What effect should be visible when an item moves in water?
wakes.configuration.fishingBobberSpawnin: What effect should be visible when a fishing bobber lands in water?
wakes.configuration.wavePropagationFacto: The impact a pixel has on its neighboring pixels inside the wakes
wakes.configuration.waveDecayFactor.tool: Specifies how much of a pixel's value is left after each tick. (Logarithmic scale)
wakes.configuration.initialStrength.tool: The strength a source starts with to produce a wake.
wakes.configuration.wakeResolution.toolt: The pixel resolution of the wakes. Good for adjusting the wakes to better visually fit some resource packs.
wakes.configuration.firstPersonSplashPla: Should the player's splash plane be seen while in first person?
wakes.configuration.shaderLightPassthrou: Brightness of wakes while a shader pack is in use. Lighting comes from the shader pack itself, so 1.0 leaves wakes untouched and lower values dim them.
wakes.configuration.shaderWaterHeightOff: Extra height added on top of the wave height detected from the loaded shader pack. Only needed for packs whose water displacement cannot be detected automatically.
